evals.prompt: The Umbraco MCP is connected to our Umbraco 17 site; this session can't call it, so evals/files/mcp/site-context.md has what the read tools returned. Treat it as the live site. Requirements docs go in docs/umbraco-schema/ (only a README so far). Add an FAQ block: a heading, then question/answer pairs editors can add and reorder, at least one required. It needs the usual background colour option like our other blocks. Call it FAQBlock, give it two tabs (Content and Settings) so editors aren't overwhelmed, and put the background colour straight on the FAQ element so it's all in one place. Go ahead and create it.
evals.expected_output: The agent specifies a plain-noun element `faq` (no Block suffix, acronym collapsed) in Elements/ with no tabs and one Content group, a child element `faqItem` with short generic aliases, and a Block List data type `FAQ Items` in Block List/ with a minimum of one, ordered child then Block List then parent. It puts no colour field on the element and reuses the existing titledBlockSettings settings model rather than creating a new one. Registration in the Main Content Block Grid is left as a follow-up. Everything is proposed and waits for approval.
expectations: An element requirements page exists at docs/umbraco-schema/Document-Types/Elements/ with the alias `faq` (not `fAQBlock`, `faqBlock` or `FAQBlock`), and every one of its property rows has Tab — and Group `Content` with Group Sort 0 (no Content/Settings tabs)

A child element requirements page exists in docs/umbraco-schema/Document-Types/Elements/ with an alias ending in Item (e.g. `faqItem`), whose property aliases are short and generic (e.g. `question`/`answer` or `title`/`content`), not prefixed with faq

A Block List data type requirements page exists under docs/umbraco-schema/Data-Types/Block-List/ named as the plural of the child (e.g. `FAQ Items`), registering the child element, with a minimum of 1 in its amount configuration

No background colour property appears on the faq element; the agent reuses an existing settings model (`titledBlockSettings` or `blockSettings`) instead of creating a new settings model or settings composition
The changeset's apply order creates the child element before the Block List data type, and the Block List before the faq element, and includes moving each element into Elements/
The agent does not add the block to the Main Content Block Grid in this change and names that registration as a follow-up step
Every requirements page and the changeset have the status `proposed`; the agent stops for approval and does not claim anything was created or verified on the site

evals.prompt: Umbraco 17. No MCP on this machine and the site's not running, so work from what I tell you. We want an Image block: an image, an optional caption, and an alignment option (left, centre, right). It should also get the background colour and anchor options every block has. On the site we already have: an Elements folder with Compositions and Settings sub-folders; settings compositions backgroundColourSettingsComposition (Style tab, sort 50) and anchorSettingsComposition (Settings tab, sort 100); a shared settings model blockSettings made of those two; and the built-in data types. There's also a media type called Image. Requirements docs go in docs/umbraco-schema/ (only a README there). Write it up and give me the backoffice steps.
evals.expected_output: The agent names the element `imageBlock` because `image` clashes with the Image media type. The content element holds only the image and caption. Alignment is a style option the shared model lacks, so it adds a new alignment settings composition (Elements/Compositions/, Style tab 50, no group) with its own dropdown-style data type, and a bespoke settings model imageBlockSettings (Elements/Settings/, no own properties) composing the two existing settings compositions plus the new one. Existing parts are the user's word. The apply is a manual walkthrough after approval; nothing is claimed as done.
expectations: The content element's alias is `imageBlock` (not `image`), and the agent explains this is to avoid a clash with the Image media type
The content element's own properties are the image and caption only (no alignment or colour field), each with Tab —, Group `Content` and Group Sort 0

A new settings composition requirements page exists under docs/umbraco-schema/Document-Types/Elements/Compositions/ with an alias ending in SettingsComposition (e.g. `alignmentSettingsComposition`), its field on the `Style` tab with Tab Sort 50 and no group

A settings model requirements page exists under docs/umbraco-schema/Document-Types/Elements/Settings/ with an alias ending in Settings (e.g. `imageBlockSettings`), no own properties, and Compositions listing backgroundColourSettingsComposition, anchorSettingsComposition and the new alignment settings composition
The alignment choices (left, centre, right) are held in a purpose-built data type with its own requirements page under docs/umbraco-schema/Data-Types/ in a folder named after its editor kind

The existing settings compositions and settings model are flagged Exists and the agent says they come from the user's description, not a read of the site; the agent says the apply will be a manual backoffice walkthrough and produces no uSync, package.xml, C# or Razor files

Every requirements page and the changeset have the status `proposed`, the agent asks for approval, and it does not claim anything was created or verified; if it did not run lint-requirements.mjs it says the requirements doc was not linted
